name: io.github.SeanHogg/builderforce-memory
title: Builderforce Memory
description: Token-saving persistent memory for AI agents. Recall durable facts — decisions, fixes, project context, user preferences — instead of re-reading files or chat history, and remember new ones as you learn them.

environmentVariables.name: BUILDERFORCE_MEMORY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the JSON snapshot that makes memory survive restarts. Defaults to ~/.builderforce-memory/memory.json, which every MCP host on the machine shares.

environmentVariables.name: BUILDERFORCE_MEMORY_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose recall only (disables memory_remember and memory_forget).

environmentVariables.name: BUILDERFORCE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Builderforce tenant API key (bfk_*). When set, additionally exposes the token_usage and model_efficiency cost tools.
